list.title: My listings
list.description: Create a listing, send it for review and see the team's answer here.
list.label: Your listings

empty.title: You have no listings yet
empty.description: Add your first listing; we keep it as a draft until you send it for review.

list.previewDescription: This is how the listing appears on the site once approved.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: Complete the listing, add at least 5 photos and send it for review.

pending_approval.title: The listing is in review
pending_approval.description: We review it within 24 hours. You cannot change it until then.

approved.title: The listing is published
approved.description: It appears on the site and on the property map.

rejected.title: The listing was rejected
rejected.description: Make the requested changes and send the listing for review again.

blocked.title: The listing was blocked
blocked.description: The listing can no longer be changed or resubmitted.

editor.submitted: The listing was sent for review.
editor.resubmitted: The listing was sent for review again.

price.label: Price

pin.label: Place on the map
